confirm.heading: Delete your account?
confirm.body: Your account closes now and nobody can see your profile. We delete it for good on {{date}}. If you change your mind, log in before then and cancel.

consequences.content: Your stories, chapters, drafts, comments and messages are deleted.
consequences.legalCase: If something you posted is part of an open legal case, we keep only that until the case ends.
consequences.records: Reports and moderation decisions about your account are kept for the time our retention schedule sets, without your profile.

confirm.logInAgainHint: So nobody else can delete your account on a device you left signed in.
confirm.confirmed: You logged in again. You can delete your account now.

failures.wrongPassword: That password isn’t right. Try again.
failures.cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed. Try again when you’re ready.
failures.failed: We couldn’t log you in again. Please try again in a minute.
failures.signInAgain: That log-in was a while ago. Log in again to confirm.
failures.staffAccount: This is a staff account. Ask an owner to remove your staff role first.
failures.deleteFailed: We couldn’t delete your account. Please try again in a minute.

closing.heading: Your account is closing
closing.body: We delete it for good on {{date}}. Until then, nobody can see your profile, your stories or your comments.
closing.changeMind: Changed your mind? Keep your account and everything comes back as it was.
closing.keepFailed: We couldn’t keep your account. Please try again in a minute.
closing.kept: Welcome back. Your account is open again.

page.heading: Delete your account

steps.confirm: Log in again to confirm, then choose Delete my account.
